text:
Ravi (People Ops): Quick help  member had an emergency cataract procedure in Mexico City. Provider is asking if Redwood can direct-bill and wants an example invoice in MXN plus an AOB template. Claim ID 2026-MX-9007. What docs do we need and who's the owner on this?

Ana (Benefits): We permit direct-bill for emergent eye surgery. Required items: signed Assignment of Benefits (AOB) from the member, itemized invoice with local procedure codes, provider bank details (CLABE/IBAN equivalent or account+SWIFT), and provider tax ID.

Marco (Finance): For Mexico payments we prefer USD wires to avoid MXN FX delays, but if provider insists on MXN send full bank details including beneficiary RFC. Also need scanned government ID for the provider signatory for KYC.

Ravi (People Ops): Can someone paste a two-line AOB snippet we can ask the member to sign and the checklist for the clinic? I just want something minimal to forward.

Ana (Benefits): AOB snippet: "I, [MemberName], hereby assign payment for medical services related to claim 2026-MX-9007 to [ProviderName] and authorize Redwood Inference to pay the provider directly. I consent to Redwood redacting my SSN and address on the EOB prior to provider/member distribution."

Marco (Finance): Provider checklist to send the clinic:
1) Signed AOB from patient (PDF)
2) Itemized invoice (MXN or USD) with procedure codes and service date
3) Provider tax ID / RFC (scanned)
4) Banking details: account number, bank name, SWIFT, CLABE if available; indicate USD acceptance if possible
5) Billing contact email/phone

ClaimsBot: Automated note  International direct-bill flagged. Manual review required. Estimated processing 4-8 business days after complete docs received.

Ravi (People Ops): Thanks  I'll send this to the clinic and ask the member to sign the AOB. One more Q: clinic asked whether we can redact CPT/procedure codes from the EOB before giving it to the member. Allowed?

Ana (Benefits): No, procedure codes and service dates must remain on the EOB for clinical audit and to verify the charge. We can redact identifiers (SSN, exact DOB, home address) with member consent. If clinic requests additional redaction, escalate to legal.

Marco (Finance): Note on timing: after docs are good, finance validates banking (1-2 business days) then initiates wire (2-5 business days depending on bank rails). If provider accepts USD, mention it in the email to speed settlement.

Ravi (People Ops): Great  forwarding now. I'll update when clinic replies. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
